title: Updating a value outside a segment
statement: Let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a,b\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers. Suppose $\mu(a+i)=l_i$ for every index $i<|l|$. If $b<a$ or $a+|l|\le b$, then changing the value of $\mu$ at $b$ to any integer leaves these values on the segment from $a$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with $l$ at every index in the segment starting at $a$
The updated index $b$ satisfies $b<a$ or $a+|l|\le b
The replacement value is an integer
